Thanks for flagging this. Short answer: we can issue a pro-rated credit for the unused GPU burst units and we typically deliver a credit note (invoice adjustment) which offsets the next invoice. For EU customers with VAT IDs we will issue the credit note with the appropriate VAT reversal.

To move forward I need:
- The exact reduction effective date (you mentioned Aug 18).
- Confirmation of the original SKU charged (I have "gpu-burst-8" on Aug 1 invoice) or attach that invoice.
- Signed amendment or short email from an authorized signer confirming the change.

I've looped in Laura from billing to confirm VAT handling and Monica to book the provisional amount so we can present a number to you by EOD Wed. We'll attach a provisional calculation and the final credit note once processed.

Hi all —

Quick notes from Billing (facts + required artifacts):
- Pro-rata method: daily basis, invoice period aligned to calendar month (UTC cutover midnight). Reduction effective 2026-08-18 means unused days = 14 (Aug 18–31 inclusive) depending on whether the reduction timestamp was at start or end of day — please confirm time.
- Calculation approach: (daily unit rate) * (units reduced) * (unused days).
- VAT: For EU companies with a valid VAT ID on file we will issue a credit note that reverses VAT on the refunded amount (credit note will reference original invoice). If the customer prefers a cash refund instead of a credit note we can arrange it but need AP approval (we prefer credit notes for accounting clarity).

Required from Tributary to issue credit note:
1) Signed amendment or email from authorized signatory confirming effective date and units.
2) Confirmation if you want the adjustment as: a) credit note to offset next invoice (default), or b) cash refund to the same payment method.

Once we receive the signed amendment we will:
- Create provisional credit note (internal reference BILL-TG-1934-PROV) within 24 hrs.
- Issue final credit note (BILL-TG-1934-CN) and post accounting entry within 3 business days after signed doc.

I'll prepare the provisional calc and hold until we confirm the exact effective timestamp.

Laura Bennett
Billing Manager, Redwood Inference

Attachment: —

Emma —

Per Laura's note, we ran the provisional numbers based on:
- SKU: "gpu-burst-8" originally billed on 2026-08-01
- Reduction effective: 2026-08-18 00:00 UTC (confirmed by your previous change ticket)
- Daily unit rate (per-unit): $12.50 USD (billing system)

Provisional credit (gross): (8 - 2) units * $12.50 * 14 days = $1,050.00 USD
Estimated VAT (20%): $210.00 USD
Net credit note amount: $840.00 (net) + VAT reversal $210.00 = $1,050.00 total credit

We will issue a credit note (preferred) referencing your VAT ID and the original invoice. If you confirm you're ok with a credit note, please send a signed amendment (one-line PDF or signed email is fine). I've attached the provisional calculation for visibility.

Marcus from Billing will process the final credit note once we receive the signed doc. Monica — can you provisionally reserve this credit in AR so it shows up against the next invoice?

Thanks,
Rishi
